s.note: Rocky living large in his Philly mansion
s.how: Top 16 blinis with creme fraiche, a fold of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill. Hard boil 6 eggs, halve them and mash the yolks with mayonnaise and salt. Pipe back into the whites and dust with paprika. Arrange everything on silver trays.

s.note: training on the beach in Los Angeles
s.how: Whisk flour with cold lager to a light batter. Dip 500g flathead strips and fry at 180C until crisp. Mix sour cream with lime juice for a crema. Fill warm corn tortillas with shredded cabbage, the fish, a spoon of crema and some fresh salsa.

m.how: Marinate 800g chicken thighs in lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano and olive oil for an hour. Grill over high heat until charred and cooked through. Serve with steamed brown rice, broccoli florets and an extra squeeze of lemon. Fuel for a training camp.

w.how: Whisk 3 yolks with 80g sugar until pale, then fold in 250g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip savoiardi biscuits briefly in cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Repeat, finish with cream, chill overnight and dust with cocoa.

d.note: the sprints on the sand with Apollo
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a big jug and add the syrup with 1.5L cold water. Bruise a handful of mint leaves and drop them in with plenty of ice. Stir well and pour into tall glasses.
